lead: Competitive activity across aviation software vendors highlights continuous EFB, flight planning, and dispatch updates alongside notable airline customer wins.

insights.title: Royal Air Maroc Selects AvioBook Flight EFB
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight Electronic Flight Bag platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service flag carrier adopting advanced cockpit digital tools.

insights.title: IFS Secures LCC and Regional Carrier Wins for EFBOne
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFBOne footprint by securing customer selections from low-cost carrier MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), African LCC fastjet, and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet are classified as low-cost carriers (LCCs), while TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Based on captured vendor announcements and LinkedIn feed items.

insights.title: Jeppesen Introduces Airflow Agents for ForeFlight Dispatch
insights.finding: Jeppesen unveiled new Trip Feasibility and Ops Briefing Airflow agents for its ForeFlight Dispatch platform at NBAA-BACE 2026.
insights.aviation_context: Targeted primarily at business aviation and advanced dispatch operations.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Lido Flight 4D and mPilot
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems implemented Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways and deployed its Lido mPilot iOS-based EFB solution for Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways operates as a full-service carrier.
insights.caveat: Signals captured from LinkedIn implementation posts.

insights.title: TransNusa Adopts Navblue Skywise Solutions
insights.finding: TransNusa signed agreements to adopt Skywise Core X2 and Fleet Performance+ to integrate its flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa is an airline integrating data-driven operations.
insights.caveat: Announced live from MRO APAC in Singapore.
